blocks.text: Ishoku Hada (異色肌) is a Japanese fashion subculture and avant-garde makeup that utilizes fantasy, unnatural skin colors like pink, bright blue, or purple to create an anime or alien-inspired look. The style originated out of Tokyo's Harajuku district around 2016 and features clubwear, mixing patterns, and bold aesthetics popularized within the the Gyaru community.

Ishoku Hada varies on colorful patterns including clothing, hair and makeup. Common motifs incorporate striped clothes, cartoon-fantasy headwears, polka dots, ribbons, animal prints, fuzzy leg warmers, weird-cute plushies, maid dresses, horns, eyepatches, kimonos, eyeglasses, big gloves (with claws), fishnets, high heels, decorated nails, manba makeup motifs, tutu dresses, checkered patterns, and holographic bags.
